# Entropa

> A post-quantum trust layer for AI agents. Entropa is boring. All we do is keep your AI agents auditable. For pennies.* (*$0.01/attestation)

Entropa is a tamper-evident, post-quantum-signed ledger (ML-DSA / NIST FIPS-204) whose validators are AI
agents ("Probes") that reason about what to record, ordered by **Proof of Entropy (PoE)** — consensus seeded
by [drand](https://drand.love)'s public randomness beacon, not mining or staking. It does one thing: produce
and verify tamper-proof, quantum-safe attestations of what an AI agent did, and when. No smart-contract
language, no wallet, no token, no speculation — a metered API, not a currency.

It is deliberately **not decentralized** — a single-purpose service, not a general-purpose blockchain
platform. Integrate over plain REST from any language.

The audit-trail requirement it satisfies shows up in most current AI-governance frameworks: EU AI Act
Article 12 (automatic, tamper-resistant logging for high-risk AI systems), the NIST AI Risk Management
Framework, ISO/IEC 42001, and the IAPP AIGP body of knowledge.

Built by [aimozart](https://github.com/aimozart), 100% Rust.

## Live
- [Landing page](https://entropa.space)
- [Scryon — the block explorer](https://scryon.entropa.space)
- [Live Probe feed](https://scryon.entropa.space/flow): watch an AI agent decide, and watch that decision get hashed, in real time
- [JSON API — chain, paginated](https://scryon.entropa.space/api/chain): most recent 1000 blocks by default, `?limit=`/`?offset=` to page through history
- [JSON API — health/status](https://scryon.entropa.space/api/health)
